fields.description: Generated by the client, stable across retries. Identifies the draft without a session, so a submitter who loses connectivity mid-wizard resumes on a new one.
fields.label: Client UUID

fields.description: Set for anonymous and IVR drafts, which have no logged-in user to key on.
fields.label: Contact Mobile

fields.description: Highest wizard step reached, so the client resumes where it stopped rather than at step 1.
fields.label: Step Reached

fields.description: Drafts are working state, not records. They are cleared after this date by the daily scheduler.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: Set once the draft becomes a grievance. Retained rather than deleted so a duplicate submit returns the original ticket instead of creating a second one.
fields.label: Submitted As

fields.description: Partial wizard answers as JSON. Deliberately unstructured: a draft is incomplete by definition and must be storable in a state the Grievance doctype would reject.
fields.label: Payload
